title.en: Tale 2 — The Coat at the Feast

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: They called Juha to a big feast.
He came in his work clothes.
The clothes were old and not clean.
He came in and said hello to everyone.
He sat in the corner beside the door.
The food passed and did not reach him.
He waited an hour and then went out.
He went home and changed clothes.
He put on a new, expensive coat.
He came back to the house of the feast.

sentences.ar: בעל הבית קם וקיבל אותו יפה.
sentences.en: The master of the house rose and received him nicely.
He sat him beside the table.
They brought him a plate full of rice.
Juha took the sleeve of the coat.
He put it into the plate.
Everyone asked: what are you doing?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הזמנתם את המעיל, לא אותי.
sentences.en: He said: you invited the coat, not me.
